SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE ED. REGISTRY No L. Q. D. 6699. Date 24. 4. 30. FOR R.）

Summarised
Translation of a letter No. 247 from the Kiangsu Shanghai Special District Court.

April 24, 1930.

Commissioner of Police,
Municipal Council.

Sir,

I have to transmit for your information and necessary action a letter received from the Kiangsu Provincial Government to the following effect:-

"A letter was received from the Kiangsu Provincial Party Affairs Reorganisation Committee quoting a petition from a man Chwang Ching Huei of Liyang enumerating the services he rendered to our Party in combating with re-actionary elements prior to the re-actionary outbreak at Liyang, to which, he explained, he was forced to join and which an order was issued for his arrest, and asking that the order be rescinded and that he be re-instated as a member of the Party. In the letter the Re-organisation Committee confirmed the contents of the petition in so far as the petitioner's services to the Party were concerned and brought to our notice a resolution passed at its 27th meeting that the order for Chwang's arrest be cancelled in view of his previous meritorious services to the Party.

The matter was referred to our Committee who passed a resolution at its 282nd meeting (cancelling the order of arrest). The Kiangsu Shanghai Special District shall take note accordingly."

Yang Shao-Shum,
President of the Court.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 编辑登记处 编号 L. Q. D. 6699。日期 1930年4月24日。供 R. 使用。）

江苏上海特区地方法院第247号来函译文摘要。

1930年4月24日。

致警察总监，
工部局。

先生：

现转呈收到江苏省政府来函一件，供贵处知悉并采取必要行动，内容如下：-

“本会收到江苏省党务整理委员会来函，引述溧阳人庄敬辉（Chwang Ching Huei）一份请愿书，列举其在溧阳反动事变爆发前，为党对抗反动分子所提供服务；据其解释，他被迫加入该反动组织，随后当局发布了他的逮捕令，故请求撤销该逮捕令并恢复其党籍。在该函中，整理委员会确认了请愿书中关于请愿人为党服务的内容属实，并提请注意该会在第二十七次会议上通过的一项决议，鉴于庄氏此前对党的功绩，取消对其的逮捕令。

此事已提交本委员会，本委员会在第二百八十二次会议上通过决议（取消逮捕令）。江苏上海特区地方法院应据此备案。”

杨绍樵（Yang Shao-Shum），
法院院长。
